verdict.rationale: PostHog exposes a full OpenAPI-documented REST API (posthog-probe-3) and docs describe building/saving insights and dashboards (posthog-docs-3, posthog-docs-25), implying programmatic access is possible, but no evidence pack item explicitly documents dashboard/insight CRUD endpoints, SDKs, or code examples for creating/updating dashboards via API. Missing for 10: explicit API reference for dashboard/insight creation, code examples, and independent confirmation of programmatic dashboard management.
